gas values are floors, not caps (D49). Before a step `gasleft()` must exceed floor plus margin or         the call reverts `InsufficientGas(step)`; the step then gets all remaining gas, so a collect that         grows past the old figure still runs. A step that reverts with `gasleft()` back under its floor is out         of gas and reports `InsufficientGas(step)`. Otherwise the revert is real: collect bubbles its revert         data, flush and convert are swallowed and reported (`FlushSkipped`, `ConvertSkipped`) so one idle or         broken slot does not block the rest (`NothingToFlush`, `ConvertTooEarly` are the common ones). Revert         data is copied up to 256 bytes (no return bomb). The floor figures are the v1 measurements (collect         658k for 14 positions, convert 299k, flush 72k) with room added, to be re measured on the v2 stack.         Recipients are the locker's frozen reward list (bounded by Constants.MAX_REWARD_PARTICIPANTS).","errors":{"InsufficientGas(uint8)":[{"details":"gas shortfall for `step` (1 collect, 2 flush, 3 convert, 4 erc165 probe)."}],"ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall()":[{"details":"Unauthorized reentrant call."}]},"kind":"dev","methods":{"preview(address)":{"returns":{"accruedArtCoin":"Sum of coin held plus escrowed across them (what `convert` can swap).","accruedPaired":"Sum of eth held plus escrowed across them (what `flushPaired` drains).","nextConvertibleBlock":"Earliest block at which any of them can convert (0 when none).","swappers":"Reward recipients that are fee swappers."}}},"title":"ArtCoinsKeeperV2","version":1},"userdoc":{"events":{"ConvertSkipped(address,address,bytes)":{"notice":"A swapper's `convert` reverted for a reason other than gas (too early, nothing to convert, ...)."},"FlushSkipped(address,address,bytes)":{"notice":"A swapper's `flushPaired` reverted for a reason other than gas (usually `NothingToFlush`)."},"SwapperServiced(address,address,uint256,uint256)":{"notice":"One fee swapper serviced. `flushed` and `converted` are gross eth, 0 when the step reverted."}},"kind":"user","methods":{"preview(address)":{"notice":"What a run could service for `token`: the swapper recipients and what they hold.
